summary.text: Sharon Wight is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 81, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Martin Carbaugh.
A project manager and lifelong Fort Wayne resident, she lists accessibility, statehouse process reform and health care among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Sharon Wight graduated from North Side High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University Fort Wayne in 2009, a graduate degree from Indiana University-Purdue University, Fort Wayne in 2012, and another graduate degree from Purdue University Global in 2022.
Her career experience includes working as a project manager.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in the northwest corner of Allen County her whole life and comes from a family of educators, engineers, farmers, union workers and clergy.
Wight won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for District 81, defeating Chad Clevidence 81.6 percent to 18.4 percent.

In her survey, she said her campaign centers on accessibility of infrastructure, language and processes, and on statehouse reform that would mean shorter legislative sessions held more often during the year.
She also said she supports a statewide single-payer health care system.
